question: The 23rd National Youth Festival to commemorate the birthday of Swami Vivekanand was held at ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Lucknow__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **23rd National Youth Festival:-**

 
 
• **NYF was held in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India from January 12th to 16th, 2020. **
 
• It was inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Yogi Adityanath, and the Minister of State (I/C) for Youth Affairs & Sports, Kiren Rijiju, **on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda, the great youth icon. **
 
• The theme of the 23rd NYF was "FIT YOUTH FIT INDIA", in pursuance of the goal of Prime Minister Narendra Modi for New India to be a fit India.
 
• The festival aimed to leverage the knowledge and ideas of today's youth, who are hugely connected and integrated through online and offline communication channels than ever before.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mumbai:-**

 
 
• **It is the financial capital of India and one of the most populous cities in the world. **
 
• It is known for its Bollywood film industry, its vibrant culture, and its iconic landmarks such as the Gateway of India and the Taj Mahal Hotel.
 
 
 
• **Dehradun**:-
 
 
• **It is the capital of the Indian state of Uttarakhand. **
 
• It is a popular tourist destination known for its scenic beauty, its pleasant climate, and its proximity to the Himalayan mountains.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**:-
 
 
• **It is the capital of India and the second most populous city in the world. **
 
• It is a historic city with a rich cultural heritage. Delhi is home to many important government buildings and monuments, such as the Red Fort, the Jama Masjid, and the Qutub Minar.
